seeds.sg-5-0-0-0: Beneath the cracked dome of the Outer Gallery, you dodge falling splinters of solar glass while Salt Court assessors bicker over land claims.
seeds.sg-5-0-0-1: Among the frozen sun-dials of the North Vestibule, a Glasswright sentinel flashes mirror codes that warn of rising basin tides and closed gates.
seeds.sg-5-0-0-2: Within the dusty cistern ring, you share stale water with Pell while heavy basalt drums signal the arrival of rival salt-tolls at the gatehouse.
seeds.sg-5-0-0-3: Beside a colossal fractured objective lens, a Dune Sister trades shelter for your pledge while distant mirrors catch the glare of approaching scavengers.
seeds.sg-5-0-1-0: Under the low lintel of the Sundered Portico, you squeeze past rusted winch gears while salt-inspectors demand immediate tax on your ceramic key.
seeds.sg-5-0-1-1: In the whistling acoustic corridor of the Whispering Arch, shifting wind drafts threaten to blow out your banked ember-lamp before you find shelter.
seeds.sg-5-0-1-2: Amidst heaps of discarded optical glass in the Shard Pit, an old lens-grinder offers a forged pass in exchange for a pinch of precious salt.
seeds.sg-5-0-1-3: Your salt-blistered arm catches a beam from the high beacons, prompting an awed sentry to unlock a hidden service hatch for you.
seeds.sg-5-0-1-4: Beside a dry bronze fountain in the Courtyard of Mirrors, rival toll-agents trade loud insults while guarding the main avenue to the observatory.
seeds.sg-5-0-1-5: Inside a ruined scriptorium choked with drift-sand, you decipher ancient glass-charts detailing the underground service conduits beneath the high lens-halls.
seeds.sg-5-0-1-6: Across the swaying rope bridge of the Great Void, a nervous Salt Court clerk drops his ledgers into the salt-crust far below.
seeds.sg-5-0-1-7: Beneath the towering prismatic spire, a wounded Glasswright sentinel presses a singing prism into your palm before sliding into unconsciousness.
seeds.sg-5-0-1-8: Within the cool shade of the Meridian Porch, you trade flat remarks with Pell about the strange silence echoing from the inner vaults.
seeds.sg-5-0-1-9: Near the western basalt bulwark, a group of tired well-keepers light a small signal fire to guide their straggling companions through the blinding glare.
seeds.sg-5-0-2-0: Through a narrow maintenance slit in the copper wall, you peer into a chamber where salt-lords argue over forged keys and hollow promises.
seeds.sg-5-0-2-1: Believing the vault holds untouched rains, you stride boldly past a nervous checkpoint while guards mistake your absolute certainty for royal authority.
seeds.sg-5-0-2-2: Within the echoing vault of the Star-Clock, brass cogs the size of cartwheels grind to a sudden halt under a drift of dry salt.
seeds.sg-5-0-2-3: Beside the frozen cascade of the Light-Well, a desperate rival drops his water-skin and begs you for a share of your canteen.
seeds.sg-5-0-2-4: Under the arched ribs of the Great Colonnade, a blind Glasswright tunes a singing pillar whose clear note masks the rumble of distant tremors.
seeds.sg-5-0-2-5: In the cramped vestibule of the Prism-Keeper, old ledgers flutter in the draft while you check your ceramic key for hairline fractures.
seeds.sg-5-0-2-6: Across the terrace of singing mirrors, sudden blinding sun-flashes from the sentry towers force you to crawl blindly along the scorching flagstones.
seeds.sg-5-0-2-7: Within the shadow of a collapsed solar furnace, Pell cleans grit from his glass-diver goggles while warning you of traps in the floor.
seeds.sg-5-0-2-8: Beneath a vaulted ceiling encrusted with salt crystals, you dodge heavy iron chains dropped by rival agents from the upper catwalks.
seeds.sg-5-0-2-9: Inside the chilly crypt of the Lens-Founders, your ember-lamp flickers over stone effigies holding empty bronze bowls that once caught dew.
seeds.sg-5-0-2-10: Near the broken sluice-gates of the Lower Basin, frantic diggers shovel white crust in a vain search for hidden emergency drainage pipes.
seeds.sg-5-0-2-11: Within the fragrant cedar-lined alcove of the Archive, a nervous clerk tries to bribe you with dried fruit to hand over your seedkey.
seeds.sg-5-0-2-12: Across the open floor of the Great Refractor, converging flash-signals from hidden sentry nests force you to seek immediate stone cover.
seeds.sg-5-0-3-0: Down the steep spiral stairs of the Ocular Tower, iron handrails burn hot from the relentless noon glare striking the upper domes.
seeds.sg-5-0-3-1: Inside the vaulted Hall of Tides, a chorus of singing glass pipes swells into a deafening tone that rattles your teeth.
seeds.sg-5-0-3-2: Across the threshold of the Amber Gallery, thick curtains of woven hemp trap the dry heat while salt-lords negotiate behind closed cedar doors.
seeds.sg-5-0-3-3: The jagged glass-burn scar on your forearm catches the low-angle prism light, illuminating a hidden spring-latch on the heavy brass door.
seeds.sg-5-0-3-4: Within the shadowed crypt of the First Astronomer, dust motes dance in the amber beam of your banked coal-lantern.
seeds.sg-5-0-3-5: Beside the silent bronze gears of the great clockwork, a discarded Salt Court ledger lies open to pages smeared with dried brine.
seeds.sg-5-0-3-6: Through the high clerestory windows of the North Scriptorium, you watch distant dust storms sweep across the pale bed of the dead sea.
seeds.sg-5-0-3-7: In the narrow conduit beneath the refracting floor, dripping condensation feeds tiny clusters of pale salt-ferns clinging to damp stone.
seeds.sg-5-0-3-8: Across the courtyard of the broken sundial, an old scavenger shouts warnings about unstable glass bridges spanning the inner chasm.
seeds.sg-5-0-3-9: Within the frescoed hall of the Seven Rains, flaking plaster reveals faded murals of green valleys that have not seen water for centuries.
seeds.sg-5-0-3-10: Near the heavy bronze valves of the lower conduits, Pell uses a copper wedge to pry open a jammed service hatch.
seeds.sg-5-0-3-11: Under the vaulted roof of the Meridian Gallery, your footsteps echo hollowly among rows of empty stone plinths that once held celestial spheres.
seeds.sg-5-0-3-12: Beside the great basalt threshold of the inner vault, a dropped lantern smolders in a puddle of spilled oil, fouling the dry air.
seeds.sg-5-0-4-0: Through the narrow gap of the double iron gates, you glimpse the towering obsidian face of the ultimate sanctuary door.
seeds.sg-5-0-4-1: Inside the vaulted vestibule of the Lens-Keepers, flickering oil lamps cast long dancing shadows across rows of silent observation desks.
seeds.sg-5-0-4-2: Across the sweeping curve of the Upper Gallery, rival agents rush toward the central approach while their heavy boots crunch on salt.
seeds.sg-5-0-4-3: Beneath the massive hanging counterweights of the great lens, you scramble through a low maintenance tunnel to avoid patrolling sentries.
seeds.sg-5-0-4-4: Within the cooling chambers of the solar furnace, thick stone walls muffle the howling wind that sweeps across the dead basin floor.
seeds.sg-5-0-4-5: Beside the deep dry well of the observatory core, Pell tests the tension of a frayed winch rope with a skeptical frown.
seeds.sg-5-0-4-6: Across the tiered stone balconies of the inner cylinder, sharp flashes of mirror signaling warn unauthorized climbers to halt immediately.
seeds.sg-5-0-4-7: Within the cramped junction box of the brass conduits, your cold ceramic key hums faintly as it comes close to the sealed vault mechanism.
seeds.sg-5-0-5-0: Before the towering bronze panels of the Lens-Hall Door, a intricate maze of interlocking optical gears blocks every straightforward approach.
seeds.sg-5-0-5-1: Facing the locked portals of the inner sanctum, Pell traces a forgotten Glasswright maintenance tunnel hidden behind a rusted brass grille.
seeds.sg-5-0-5-2: At the threshold of the massive lens-hall doors, you fumble with improvised tools while rival footsteps echo louder down the corridor behind you.
seeds.sg-5-0-5-3: Standing before the heavy adamantine latch of the vault entrance, you raise your cold ceramic key as the great clockwork mechanism begins to groan.
